purpose: Non-admission source discovery for Cologne flood, municipal geographies and urban trees; distinguishes official reusable NRW dataset listings from viewing-only StEB 3D maps, with no data/model admission.

entries.name: Cologne municipal statistical geography GeoPackage and KGG WFS (2026)
entries.provider: Stadt Köln, Amt für Stadtentwicklung und Statistik
entries.spatial_scope: Stadt Köln, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany; municipal statistical geographies, districts and street/block units, not a national building inventory
entries.temporal_scope: Continuously maintained publisher collection; public dataset page updated 2026-09-24; exact ZIP and WFS feature revision not yet captured
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Published GeoPackage ZIP plus WFS collection service with city, district, neighbourhood, statistical-quarter, block and other municipal planning divisions; address data provided via separate district-scoped service
entries.note: Official Stadt Köln dataset updated 2026-09-24 lists ZIP GeoPackage RBS and KGG Sammeldienst WFS/WMS; attributes include municipal geographies and separately described address relations to ALKIS building IDs and building functions. Some address layers are published through another district-scoped service. No ZIP bytes or live WFS GetFeature receipt acquired in this review. Verify exact distribution URLs, per-asset reuse rights and WFS schema, CRS, update timestamp and identifiers before any data/model acquisition. Statistical geography is not owner, insurer, insured address or property TIV.

entries.name: Stadt Köln continuously updated managed-tree register, WFS and WMS (2026)
entries.provider: Stadt Köln, Amt für Landschaftspflege und Grünflächen
entries.spatial_scope: Köln municipal street trees and city-managed trees on municipal objects only; not the complete urban tree stock
entries.temporal_scope: Publisher dataset metadata updated 2025-11-27, source describes daily updates; exact live WFS vintage not pinned
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Individual managed trees with tree identifier, species, planting year, stem size, height, crown diameter and neighbourhood where recorded; WFS and WMS distributions
entries.note: The city explicitly limits the register to municipally managed trees and warns that location/crown coordinates are not an official site survey; the data may contain gaps after a system migration. It is not a probability of tree failure or measured wind vulnerability. Verify individual WFS endpoint, licence, exact attributes, absent values and geometry before bounded source receipts. Do not ingest ownership-like fields or infer private-tree presence or insured claims.

entries.name: NRW HWRM high-probability flood hazard depths, boundaries and velocities
entries.spatial_scope: North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany; to be clipped to Cologne only after geospatial and rights review
entries.temporal_scope: Original publisher HWRM folder lists original high-probability Shape ZIP updates on 2026-01-29 and GeoTIFF ZIP updates on 2026-01-30; exact archive content digest and underlying model-vintage semantics pending source acquisition
entries.resolution_or_granularity: EPSG:25832 state-wide depth GeoTIFF ZIP (publisher-listed 2.4 GB), depth-in-risk-area GeoTIFF ZIP (1.1 GB), flood boundaries (142.9 MB) and velocities (5.2 MB) as Shapefile ZIP; WMS for display; no download performed
entries.note: Original Open.NRW resource provides specific high-probability depth TIFF ZIP https://www.opengeodata.nrw.de/produkte/umwelt_klima/wasser/hochwasser/hwrm/HQhaeufig-Tiefen-UeberschwemmungsGebiete_EPSG25832_TIFF.zip and WMS https://www.wms.nrw.de/umwelt/wasser/HW_Gefahrenkarte?REQUEST=GetCapabilities&SERVICE=WMS ; catalogue shows Datenlizenz Deutschland Zero 2.0 for named distributions. High probability HQ10-HQ50 is a regulatory scenario grouping, not a stochastic single-event loss frequency or building-level measured water height. Must pin original ZIP bytes, depth units, NoData, flood defence assumptions and version before admitted hazard raster or commercial use. Capabilities probe code is metadata-only. Exact original publisher index: https://www.opengeodata.nrw.de/produkte/umwelt_klima/wasser/hochwasser/hwrm/ ; direct release filenames and sizes were cross-checked there on 2026-11-14. Official WMS GetCapabilities Service/AccessConstraints inspected 2026-11-14 through a third-party public XML view and states Datenlizenz Deutschland Namensnennung 2.0 with required attribution 'Land NRW'; this is different from the official downloadable HWRM archive directory, which displays DL-DE Zero 2.0. These per-distribution terms must not be conflated. The XML view showed WMS name, Service/Title, GetCapabilities and GetMap, but no original response-byte SHA-256 or executable verified_live receipt. Do not mistake external XML-to-Markdown conversion for original WMS bytes.

entries.name: StEB Köln interactive 3D pluvial and flood hazard viewer (2025)
entries.spatial_scope: Stadt Köln, Germany; public interactive view for heavy rainfall and Rhine/tributary or groundwater flood scenarios
entries.temporal_scope: New 3D heavy-rainfall visualisation published June 2025; future updates and scenario versions need provider confirmation
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Interactive scenario visualisation with water levels at buildings, flow indicators and evolving storm snapshots; no confirmed machine download of original numerical model grids
entries.note: StEB describes its city-wide maps and visual rainfall simulations, but publication of an interactive free viewer is not a data-download or redistribution grant. Treat numerical tiles, depths, temporal sequences and any embedded application calls as unavailable for automated source acquisition unless the provider explicitly documents a machine endpoint and its licensing. Do not reverse-engineer or scrape viewer payloads. A scenario display alone is neither empirical event hazard nor a calibrated stochastic model.
